ministry.en: Ministry of Women and Child Development

en.name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (maternity support)
en.summary: Money support for pregnant women and new mothers, so they can rest before and after the birth and eat well.
en.benefit: For the first child: ₹5,000 in two instalments, ₹3,000 after registering the pregnancy and one check-up, and ₹2,000 after the birth is registered and the baby gets the first vaccines. With Janani Suraksha Yojana for a hospital birth, this comes to about ₹6,000 on average. For a second child who is a girl: ₹6,000 in one instalment after the birth.
en.how_to_apply: Register at your Anganwadi centre or approved health facility, or on the PMMVY website. Apply within 730 days of the pregnancy date on your MCP card. For a second child, you must register during the pregnancy. Payment needs Aadhaar and goes to your bank or post office account.

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना
hi.summary: गर्भवती महिलाओं और नई माताओं के लिए पैसों की मदद, ताकि वे जन्म से पहले और बाद में आराम कर सकें और अच्छा खा सकें।
hi.benefit: पहले बच्चे के लिए: ₹5,000 दो किस्तों में, गर्भावस्था के पंजीकरण और एक जाँच के बाद ₹3,000, और जन्म का पंजीकरण व बच्चे के पहले टीकों के बाद ₹2,000। अस्पताल में जन्म पर जननी सुरक्षा योजना के साथ यह औसतन लगभग ₹6,000 होता है। दूसरी संतान बेटी होने पर: जन्म के बाद एक किस्त में ₹6,000।
hi.how_to_apply: अपने आंगनवाड़ी केंद्र या मान्य स्वास्थ्य केंद्र पर, या पीएमएमवीवाई वेबसाइट पर पंजीकरण करें। MCP कार्ड पर लिखी गर्भावस्था की तारीख़ से 730 दिन के भीतर आवेदन करें। दूसरी संतान के लिए गर्भावस्था के दौरान ही पंजीकरण ज़रूरी है। भुगतान के लिए आधार चाहिए और पैसा आपके बैंक या डाकघर खाते में आता है।

rules.quote: maternity benefit of not less than rupees five thousand, in two instalments will be provided to women belonging to socially and economically disadvantaged sections of society
provides for financial support for pregnant and lactating mothers is to improve the health and nutrition for mother and child

text.hi: गर्भवती हैं या स्तनपान करा रही हैं

rules.quote: all pregnant women and lactating mothers in regular employment with the central Government or State Government or public Sector Undertaking or those who are in receipt of similar benefits under any law for the time being in force shall not be entitled to benefits under PMMVY.

text.en: Not in regular employment with the central or state government or a PSU
text.hi: केंद्र या राज्य सरकार या सार्वजनिक उपक्रम की नियमित नौकरी में नहीं हैं

rules.quote: The criteria for determining socially and economically disadvantaged sections of society will be the following: i. Women belonging to scheduled castes and scheduled tribes; ii. Women who are partially (40%) or fully disabled (Divyang Jan) iii. Women holder of BPL ration Card

text.en: Belongs to a listed group: SC or ST, 40% or more disability, BPL ration card, PM-JAY card, e-Shram card, MGNREGA job card, or family income below ₹8 lakh a year. Women farmers on PM-KISAN and pregnant or breastfeeding Anganwadi or ASHA workers are also listed. This app cannot check those groups, so ask the office.
text.hi: इनमें से किसी समूह से हैं: अनुसूचित जाति या जनजाति, 40% या ज़्यादा दिव्यांगता, बीपीएल राशन कार्ड, पीएम-जेएवाई कार्ड, ई-श्रम कार्ड, मनरेगा जॉब कार्ड, या परिवार की आय साल में ₹8 लाख से कम। पीएम-किसान वाली महिला किसान और गर्भवती या स्तनपान कराने वाली आंगनवाड़ी या आशा कार्यकर्ता भी सूची में हैं। ऐप इन समूहों की जाँच नहीं कर सकता, इसलिए कार्यालय से पूछें।

facts.quote: In case of the first child the amount of ₹5000 in two instalments and for the second child, the benefit of ₹6000 will be provided subject to second child is a girl child in one instalment after the birth.

On registration of pregnancy and at least one Ante-natal check-up within 6 months from LMP date at the Anganwadi Centre (AWC)/ approved Health facilities may be identified by the respective administering State /UT ₹ 3,000/-
Child has received first cycle of BCG, OPV,DPT and Hepatitis-B or its equivalent/substitute ₹ 2,000/-
The eligible beneficiaries would receive the remaining cash incentives as per approved norms towards maternity benefit under Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) after institutional delivery
However, for availing benefits for second child, registration during the pregnancy shall be mandatory.
An eligible beneficiary can apply, at any point of time but not later than 730 days of pregnancy. LMP registered in the MCP card will be the date of pregnancy to be considered in this respect.
The funds to the beneficiaries under PMMVY will be transferred directly to their Bank/Post Office account in Direct Benefit Transfer Mode.
